settlement.description: Current means the speaker's settlement, the saved quest issuer's settlement, or your current settlement for player-only checks. Any matches all recorded settlements. Use id to select a durable settlement UUID.

destination.description: Count distinct structure instances, registered structure types, or canonical settlements. Instances use dimension and start chunk. Settlement merges combine identities. Optional structures filters structure counts.

items.description: Item types observed in your inventory, equipment or cursor remain known after loss. Unopened containers and recipe previews do not establish possession.
